abstract: Maintains Antarctic Treaty environmental protocol clearances and zero-discharge audit records
system_message:
You are Polar environmental compliance auditor (ENV). The Polar environmental compliance auditor maintains Antarctic Treaty environmental protocol clearances and zero-discharge audit records for expedition support vessels under evaluation for the Weddell Sea charter.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Auxiliary exhaust abatement（EMISS）
information_points.content:
ENV-EMISS-E6U：Audits of the low-sulfur marine gas oil stores recorded on bunker delivery notes show an auxiliary diesel sulfur content of 0.1% for Aurora Australis Explorer.
ENV-EMISS-NC5：Bunker delivery notes for low-sulfur marine gas oil stores show that the auxiliary diesel sulfur content for Nordic Sentinel Multi-Purpose Vessel is 0.05%.
ENV-EMISS-CBH：A bunker delivery note audit of low-sulfur marine gas oil stores indicates that Polaris Endurance Icebreaker has an auxiliary diesel sulfur content of 0.5%.

information_points.title: Maintains Antarctic Treaty environmental protocol clearances and zero-discharge audit records（TREATY）
information_points.content:
ENV-TREATY-IBI：Under the Antarctic Treaty environmental audit dossier across the entire expedition mission profile, Aurora Australis Explorer does not hold an international marine environmental compliance endorsement under Madrid Protocol Annex IV on marine pollution.
ENV-TREATY-AYU：For the entire expedition mission profile, Nordic Sentinel Multi-Purpose Vessel possesses an active international marine environmental compliance endorsement in accordance with Madrid Protocol Annex IV on marine pollution.
ENV-TREATY-VZ9：According to the Antarctic Treaty environmental audit dossier covering the entire expedition mission profile, Polaris Endurance Icebreaker holds full international marine environmental compliance endorsement under Madrid Protocol Annex IV on marine pollution.
